#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define rep(i, n) for (int i = 0; i < (n); i++)
#define repr(i, n) for (int i = (n) - 1; i >= 0; i--)

using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

struct mincostflow {
  struct edge {
    int v;
    long long c;
    long long w;
    int r;
  };

  vector<vector<edge>> G;

  mincostflow(int n) : G(n) {}

  void add(int u, int v, long long c, long long w) {
    int i = G[u].size();
    int j = G[v].size();
    G[u].push_back({v, c, w, j});
    G[v].push_back({u, 0, -w, i});
  }

  long long run(int s, int t, long long f) {
    const int N = G.size();
    long long res = 0;
    vector<long long> H(N);
    vector<long long> D(N);
    const long long INF = 1e18;
    vector<int> PE(N), PV(N);
    while (f > 0) {
      priority_queue<pair<long long, int>> q;
      fill(D.begin(), D.end(), INF);
      D[s] = 0;
      q.emplace(0, s);
      while (!q.empty()) {
        long long d = -q.top().first;
        int u = q.top().second;
        q.pop();
        if (D[u] < d) continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < G[u].size(); i++) {
          edge e = G[u][i];
          if (e.c > 0 && D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]) {
            D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v];
            q.emplace(-D[e.v], e.v);
            PV[e.v] = u;
            PE[e.v] = i;
          }
        }
      }
      if (D[t] == INF) return -1;
      for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) H[i] += D[i];
      long long d = f;
      for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
        d = min(d, G[PV[i]][PE[i]].c);
      }
      f -= d;
      res += d * H[t];
      for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
        edge &e = G[PV[i]][PE[i]];
        e.c -= d;
        G[i][e.r].c += d;
      }
    }
    return res;
  }
};

int main() {
  cin.tie(nullptr);
  ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
  ll N, M, K, C, D;
  cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
  vector<int> A(K);
  rep(i, K) cin >> A[i], A[i]--;
  vector<int> us(M), vs(M);
  rep(i, M) {
    cin >> us[i] >> vs[i];
    us[i]--;
    vs[i]--;
  }
  mincostflow mcf(N*101+2);
  int s = N*101;
  int t = s + 1;
  for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
    mcf.add(s, A[i], 1, 0);
  }
  for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
    mcf.add(N * i, t, K, C*i);
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
      mcf.add(i*N+j, (i+1)*N+j, K, 0);
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
      for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
        mcf.add(N*i + us[j], N*(i+1) + vs[j], 1, (2*k-1)*D);
        mcf.add(N*i + vs[j], N*(i+1) + us[j], 1, (2*k-1)*D);
      }
    }
  }
  cout << mcf.run(s, t, K) << '\n';
}

import heapq
import sys

class mincostflow:
    class edge:
        def __init__(self, v, c, w, r):
            self.v = v
            self.c = c
            self.w = w
            self.r = r

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, w):
        i = len(self.G[u])
        j = len(self.G[v])
        self.G[u].append(self.edge(v, c, w, j))
        self.G[v].append(self.edge(u, 0, -w, i))

    def run(self, s, t, f):
        N = len(self.G)
        res = 0
        H = [0] * N
        D = [float('inf')] * N
        INF = 1e18
        PE = [0] * N
        PV = [0] * N
        while f > 0:
            q = []
            for u in range(N):
                D[u] = INF
            D[s] = 0
            heapq.heappush(q, (-D[s], s))
            while q:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(q)
                if D[u] < -d: continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.G[u]):
                    if e.c > 0 and D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]:
                        D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]
                        heapq.heappush(q, (-D[e.v], e.v))
                        PV[e.v] = u
                        PE[e.v] = i
            if D[t] == INF: return -1
            for i in range(N):
                H[i] += D[i]
            d = f
            for i in range(t, s, -1):
                d = min(d, self.G[PV[i]][PE[i]].c)
            f -= d
            res += d * H[t]
            for i in range(t, s, -1):
                e = self.G[PV[i]][PE[i]]
                e.c -= d
                self.G[i][e.r].c += d
        return res

def main():
    N, M, K, C, D = map(int, input().split())
    A = list(map(int, input().split()))[:K]
    for i in range(K): A[i] -= 1
    us = list(map(int, input().split()))[:M]
    vs = list(map(int, input().split()))[:M]
    for i in range(M): us[i] -= 1; vs[i] -= 1
    mcf = mincostflow(N*101+2)
    s = N*101
    t = s + 1
    for i in range(K):
        mcf.add(s, A[i], 1, 0)
    for i in range(101):
        mcf.add(N * i, t, K, C*i)
    for i in range(100):
        for j in range(N):
            mcf.add(i*N+j, (i+1)*N+j, K, 0)
        for j in range(M):
            for k in range(1, K+1):
                mcf.add(N*i + us[j], N*(i+1) + vs[j], 1, (2*k-1)*D)
                mcf.add(N*i + vs[j], N*(i+1) + us[j], 1, (2*k-1)*D)
    print(mcf.run(s, t, K))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.stdin = open(0)
    main()
